latest.title: New Recurring Tasks, Streaks Can Earn You Extra Rewards, And More!
features: New Recurring task series can now be enabled per task template.
New Quick login via Passkey or PIN is now supported for faster family access.
improvements: Renamed the Family Tab to Settings for more intuitive navigation and clarity.
Added family timezone configuration in Settings tab with smart defaults for better scheduling and consistency across timezones.
Redesigned app icons and splash screens for a fresh new look.
Better caching of credentials for easier login experiences, especially on mobile.
Added date and time to notifications for better context on recent activity.
Moved Ticket Conversion Rate to Settings tab
Added account security options to Settings tab for passkey and PIN login management.
fixes: Fixed activity feed wording on sender and receiver when sending tickets to a child.
Fixed app icon not updating on Android after the latest release.

0.3.1.title: New Recurring Tasks, Streaks Can Earn You Extra Rewards, And More!
features: Recurring task series can now be enabled per task template with daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly cadence options.
Recurring task streaks with milestone rewards (ticket or custom) are now supported.
Parents can now pause or resume recurring series directly from the Manage activity feed.
Family timezone can now be explicitly configured, with container timezone fallback when unset.

0.2.1.title: Better Account Control; Lifecycle for Rewards
features: Parents and children can now delete their own account in-app with typed DELETE confirmation.
Self-hosters can now list and delete users/families through host management CLI tools.
improvements: Activity feed now groups reward actions into lifecycle cards, including store purchase request/approval/rejection flow.
Deletion rules are centralized so app and CLI flows enforce consistent family teardown behavior.
fixes: Resolved deletion failures caused by leftover push subscription rows tied to deleted users.
Member updates now broadcast a dedicated family-members wallet update reason to refresh active clients.

0.1.0.title: Better, faster, stronger: BribeBank's latest update is here!
features: Admin Approvals has been refactored into a Manage tab with unified task/reward management.
Parents and children can now cancel unverified tasks to close stale assignments cleanly.
Added one-time in-app release highlights modal after updates.
Added self-hoster emergency CLI parent password recovery path.
improvements: Parents are now prompted to set up a family recovery key to avoid account lockouts.
Admin and wallet history now use one newest-first activity feed instead of split lifecycle/legacy sections.
fixes: Password changes now immediately invalidate stale sessions so old tokens can no longer be used.
Users are now automatically returned to login as soon as a stale session is detected.
Fixed mobile update modal clipping by making update dialogs viewport-safe and scrollable.
FCFS tasks now close lifecycle history for users who missed the claim, including who claimed first.
Corrected task lifecycle status handling for denied-without-resubmit outcomes in wallet history.
Stabilized update delivery by replacing manual update confirmation with immediate automatic refresh.
